This document explains why an update to this modelling is needed for the new Dakar CAP update . It recommends next steps and further reading to support this exercise. If you are unfamiliar with scenario modelling, please see: C40 Emissions Scenario Modelling Memo Why is an update to Dakar’s emissions scenarios modelling (Pathways) necessary? Figure 1: Dakar’s original emissions scenarios and emissions progress to date There is a need for Dakar to update the emissions scenario modelling for their CAP update. Nous nous devons ainsi d’entreprendre des efforts ambitieux afin de le combattre et de s’adapter à ses conséquences.
